# omics-skills 1.6.0

Version 1.6.0 makes skills cheaper for an agent to run: workflow drivers
report a bounded JSON envelope, one new skill fetches records from eight public
databases, and the skill files carry less boilerplate. It also ships the audit
fixes prepared as 1.5.1, which were never tagged. The package contains four
agents and 35 skills for Claude Code and Codex.

## Driver stdout contract

- The eight workflow drivers (`bio-annotation`, `bio-assembly-qc`,
  `bio-gene-calling`, `bio-interdomain-hgt`, `bio-phylogenomics`,
  `bio-protein-clustering-pangenome`, `bio-reads-qc-mapping`, `bio-viromics`)
  print one JSON envelope as the last line of stdout:
  `{ok, skill, out, manifest, warnings}` on success, or
  `{ok: false, skill, error: {code, message}}` with the message on stderr and
  exit code 2 when the driver detects a failure.
- The contract is documented in `AGENTS.md` and in each skill's Output section.

## New skill: public-db-lookup

- One bounded HTTP GET against UniProt, NCBI Entrez, NCBI Datasets, MGnify,
  InterPro, AlphaFold DB, STRING, or ENA.
- Retries on 429 and 5xx, sends a User-Agent, reads NCBI credentials from
  `NCBI_API_KEY`, `NCBI_EMAIL`, and `NCBI_TOOL`, and rejects an API key passed
  on the command line.
- Compacts the response (`--max-items`, `--max-depth`) and writes the full
  payload to disk with `--save-raw`.
- Per-service cards with paths, record paths, and documented rate limits live
  in `references/services.md`.

## Leaner skill files

- The validator now requires four non-empty sections (Instructions, Input
  Requirements, Output, Quality Gates). Quick Reference, Examples,
  Troubleshooting, and Non-Goals are optional.
- Placeholder tables and troubleshooting rows were removed from ten `bio-*`
  skills (981 to 794 lines in total).
- Output sections link the artifact schema where one ships.
- `bio-annotation`, `bio-viromics`, and `bio-interdomain-hgt` gained Non-Goals
  sections and a deterministic ordering rule for their candidate tables.
- All four agents state how to report script and API output: Markdown
  summaries by default, raw JSON on request, large payloads to disk.

## Included from the unreleased 1.5.1

- Citation gate with cached DOI registration and title checks; removal of
  literature-summary directories with unreliable metadata.
- Pytest collection in CI, frontmatter and link validation, documented-command
  and output-artifact checks.
- Word-boundary routing with hard negatives; routing-benchmark failures fail
  the gate.
- Atomic stage-completion markers in the read QC, assembly QC, and
  phylogenomics drivers; newest-first bioRxiv interval scans with author-name
  variants.

## Validation

- 295 tests and 23 subtests pass.
- The routing benchmark passes 64 of 64 cases.
- Skill-definition, supplementary-doc, citation, catalog, and strict MkDocs
  checks pass.

Run `make install` after updating to expose all 35 skills and four agents.
